name: Princess Kingdom
release_name: Complete Princess Mode and Princess Album enhancement
changes: Added 35 original princess portraits to complete the 50-subject image set; every challenge now stores an explicit image path.
Added a resilient local fallback portrait for image load failures.
Redesigned Princess Mode challenge cards with larger hero artwork, readable headings, and the princess name below the portrait.
Added the Princess Album with 50 collectible cards; each princess unlocks after all three of her category challenges are completed.
Added the album portrait and unlock-state rendering to the Princess Mode experience.
Added automated release tests for all 150 Princess Mode challenges, unique IDs, all 50 image paths, fallback assets, mode-specific progress keys, and version consistency.
Centralized the release version in VERSION and synchronized app metadata, progress export, footer, and PWA cache.
Added CREDITS.md with asset-by-asset artwork provenance notes.
